arabic text: Zere khanjar ya hussain noke sina par ya hussain
english translation text: Beneath the dagger, O Hussain; upon the spear-point, O Hussain

arabic text: Marhala hai faisle ka muntazir tawheed hai, mehve sajda ek\nghazi per khuda ki deed hai, sab se bartar ya hussain, khud ke\nbaraabar ya hussain
english translation text: The moment of decision has arrived, and tawheed waits; a warrior is absorbed in prostration,\nand God Himself beholds him. Above all others, O Hussain; equal to none but God,\nO Hussain

arabic text: De chuka tu sar kata kar ta abad deen ko amaan, ruk gayin\njumbizh zameen ki kaanp utha aasmaan, rab pukara kab hai koi,\ntera humsar ya hussain
english translation text: By offering your head, you granted the faith protection forever; the movement of\nthe earth stopped and the heavens trembled. The Lord proclaimed: where is anyone,\nyour equal, O Hussain?

arabic text: Noke neza ke musafir tu azeem or sar buland, bibyon ke sar\nkhule hai yun teri aankhen hai band, aankh hai sajaad ki, khoon\nka samander ya hussain
english translation text: O traveller upon the spear-point, you are lofty and exalted; the ladies' heads\nare uncovered while your eyes are closed. Sajjad's eyes have become an ocean\nof blood, O Hussain

arabic text: Aakhri sajda wo tera or musala karbala, roze ashura huwa kaabe\nka qibla karbala, karbala hai woh jahaan, bikhra tera ghar ya\nhussain
english translation text: Your final prostration and the prayer mat of Karbala; on Ashura, Karbala became\nthe qibla of the Kaaba. Karbala is the land where your entire household\nwas scattered, O Hussain

arabic text: Isne kis tarha sameta qasime noshah ko, isne kis tarha se roka\nlab pe aakhri aah ko, ek ek tukra pukara, tha bikhar kar ya husain
english translation text: How did he gather the body of the bridegroom Qasim? How did he restrain\nthe final sigh upon his lips? Every scattered piece cried out, O Hussain

arabic text: Yeh agar mehshar nahin hai, phir bhala mehshar hai kya, hai\nkhule sar binte zehra yeh hai mehshar se siwa, ghayr ke har ek\nnazar hai, misle khanjar ya hussain.
english translation text: If this is not the Day of Judgement, then what is Judgement? Zahra's daughter stands\nbareheaded—this is beyond Judgement. Every stranger's gaze is like\na dagger, O Hussain

arabic text: Lehd mein aabid se tere kya sawal or kya jawab, saath\nrakhwalunga sirhane me nawho ki kitaab kuch nahin likha hai\nlikha zindagi bhar ya hussain
english translation text: In the grave, what question and answer can there be for your servant? I will keep\na book of laments beside my head. Nothing else has been written—only,\nthroughout life: O Hussain
